scope: Generation under explicitly fixed training evidence; not retrieval efficacy, live session behavior, speech or avatar quality.
source_context_policy: Heldout original earlier-speaker turns omitted from inference; exact original questions and private references retained.
history_policy: Three development cases use authored fixed earlier-user context and the protocol acknowledgement; they are not actual multi-turn conversation executions.
answerability_review: agent classification against eligible training material before model generations; human reference/support review remains ungraded

input_tokens.counter: actual pinned Qwen3 tokenizer chat template with enable_thinking=False

runtime_plan.conditional_fallback: Use bfloat16 for every condition only if actual float32 memory smoke does not fit. Record measured runtime; the precision probe is not an end-to-end speed claim.
runtime_plan.model_execution_gate: wait for shared memory slot and completed compatible adapter receipt

style_constraints: The existing Korean factual prompt requires one sentence, third person and no direct quotations.
This constraint limits expressiveness and the interpretation of adapter/style similarity.
Current-position and unseen-future controls have no eligible style examples under the temporal snapshot; their facts/style prompts coincide.
source_wording_notes: Whole selected source answers, questions and context are retained without evaluation-time truncation.
Publisher transcripts retain disfluencies and interruptions; the selected Sega turn ends in a publisher-labeled interruption, and only its supported complete claims are evaluation targets.

development.reason: Initial preflight sealed before condition-neutral modality labels were applied. Same cases, selections, facts, references and cutoff; no output was generated.

heldout.reason: Initial preflight sealed before condition-neutral modality labels were applied. Same cases, selections, facts, references and cutoff; no output was generated.

promotion: Keep adapter opt-in pending actual matched execution and support/control review; this registration is not an acceptance result.
